description: Cross-checks the legal-worker corpus output against the on-chain legal_source_manifest PDA for a given jurisdiction. Detects tampering / drift between the off-chain corpus and the on-chain hash anchor. Returns verdict in {in-sync, drift, not-anchored, no-corpus}. Closes the chain-of-custody loop for resolve_legal_citation.

jurisdiction.description: Worker jurisdiction code (LGPD, GDPR, MICAR, POPIA, DPDP, APPI, PIPA, PDP-ID, Malaysia-PDPA, Vietnam-Decree-13, PDPA-SG, PIPEDA, CCPA, LFPDPPP, PDPL-UAE, BriberyAct-UK). Internally maps to ≤16-byte on-chain ASCII code when needed.

name: verify_corpus_manifest_onchain
